note: Committed baseline for deterministic bench metrics: counts, byte totals and fractions of a fixed capacity. NEVER a duration -- scripts/bench-gate.py refuses to write one, because a committed duration is a wall-clock ceiling on whatever machine recorded it. Move a value with `just bench-baseline-update` and commit the diff alongside the change that moved it; the band is two-way, so an unexplained improvement is red too. First recorded on macbook.local (aarch64, macOS, `bench` profile); cross-machine agreement is verified by CI's own first run of the bench-gate job, and a disagreement there is evidence that the metric is not machine-independent rather than evidence of a regression.
